### Comparing before and after swarm

```{r}
Hash_b4 <- read_csv(here("data/UNOISE_March_2025/demultiplexed_20250326/Hash_key.csv"))

Hash_after <- read_csv(here("data/UNOISE_March_2025/demultiplexed_20250326/new_Hash_key_after_swarm.csv"))

# En teoria, no debe haber ninguna secuencia after awrm que no existiera anteriormente en el before swarm

Hash_after |> anti_join(Hash_b4)

# Correcto

full_join(Syntax_Midori_190325, Syntax_Midori_260325) -> ALL_SYNTAX_MIDORI


Hash_b4 |>
  anti_join(ALL_SYNTAX_MIDORI) |> 
  eDNAfuns::fasta_writer(header = Hash, sequence = sequence, file.out = here("data/new_seqs_for_syntax_midori.fasta"))
  
```

## Nueva asignación taxonómica

Usando rCRUX con Sintax. El input file eran los hashes despues de swarm
```{r}
SINTAX_rCRUX <- read_csv(here("data/asignacion_taxonomica_sintax_r_crux_new_hash_after_swarm_270325.csv"))
```

```{r}
new_ASV_after_swarm <- read_csv(here("data/UNOISE_March_2025/demultiplexed_sin_singletons/new_ASV_after_swarm.csv"))
new_Hash_after_swarm <- read_csv(here("data/UNOISE_March_2025/demultiplexed_sin_singletons/new_Hash_key_after_swarm.csv")) |> 
  filter (!is.na(Hash))
```
```{r}
colnames(SINTAX_rCRUX)[-1] -> taxonomy_cols

SINTAX_rCRUX |> inner_join(new_ASV_after_swarm |> group_by(Hash) |> summarise(nr = sum(nReads), nocc = n())) |> 
  filter (!is.na(Hash)) |> 
  unite (all_of(taxonomy_cols), col = "taxa", sep = "|")
```
get the fasta

```{r}
SINTAX_rCRUX |> 
  anti_join(Hash_after)
```
